style.description: Output style. Can be: nested, expanded, compact, compressed.

line_numbers.description: Emit comments showing original line numbers (--line-numbers).

source_map.description: Emit source map. Can be: auto, inline.

omit_map_comment.description: Omits the source map url comment (--omit-map-comment).

load_paths.description: Set Sass import paths (--load-path). List of strings.
